en: Vintage stereoscopic postcard showing two nearly identical black‑and‑white images of a row of tall Corinthian columns from an ancient Greek temple ruin. A few people stand near the base of the columns. In the background, on a rocky hill, another monumental complex is visible, resembling the Acropolis. The bottom center contains a printed French caption referring to the temple, partially legible, and there is a circular stamp mark on the left and a website watermark across the lower center.
